title: review edit!!!
text: review edit!!!. This rug sucks!!! Ugh no way don't waste your money and run for your dear life after 6 months of use it looks like hell knowing it's just my husband and I and not like we have 7 children running around, it looks like it's already 10 years old it still creased from it arriving rolled so hard it never stays in place and honestly I'm going to move it to the kitchen instead of throwing it away only because my cat uses it as a scratching mat.
